title: The Room Is Not Ready
summaryZh: 銜接「飯店入住登記」：房間尚未準備好時，聽清楚等待時間、再次確認，並決定何時回來。

learning.objectiveZh: 聽出房間還沒準備好，問清楚可入住時間，並確認自己何時回來。

vocabulary.en: A reservation recorded under a person's name.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 以 Chen 的名字訂房

vocabulary.en: To report your arrival and receive your hotel room.
Prepared and able to be used.
To let your bags stay here while you go elsewhere.
vocabulary.example: leave your bags at the desk

vocabulary.en: On the other side of the street.

task.titleZh: 換個條件：四點才能入住
task.setupZh: 你姓 Chen，住一晚。房間現在還沒好；請問清楚時間，沒聽清楚就再確認，最後說你幾點回來。

steps.partner: I'm sorry. Your room isn't ready yet.
steps.promptZh: 詢問房間幾點會準備好。
steps.sample: What time will it be ready?

steps.partner: It will be ready at four this afternoon.
steps.promptZh: 你沒有聽清楚。確認是三點還是四點。
steps.sample: Did you say three or four?

steps.partner: Four. You can leave your bags here.
steps.promptZh: 表示知道了，並說你四點回來。
steps.sample: Thanks. I'll come back at four.

success: 我有聽出現在還不能入住。
我有再次確認正確時間是四點。
我有說清楚自己四點回來。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hi, I have a booking under Lin.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Welcome. You're staying for two nights, right?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yes. Can I check in now?
sentences.zh: 對。現在可以辦理入住嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I'm sorry. Your room isn't ready yet.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，您的房間還沒準備好。
sentences.note: 留意 isn't ready yet：目前還沒準備好。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: What time will it be ready?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Did you say two or three?
sentences.zh: 你剛才說兩點還是三點？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Three. You can leave your bags here.
sentences.zh: 三點。您可以把行李寄放在這裡。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Great. Is there a cafe nearby?
sentences.zh: 太好了。附近有咖啡店嗎？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll come back at three.

questions.explanationZh: 櫃檯說 Your room isn't ready yet，表示房間還沒準備好。

questions.q: 櫃檯最後確認的入住時間是？
questions.explanationZh: 旅客問 two or three，櫃檯再次確認 Three。
櫃檯回答 just across the street，也就是街對面。
